relationships.subject: Wei-Tong-Xin
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro, WTX activated the nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)/heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) signaling pathway and inactivated mitophagy in GES-1 cells.

relationships.subject: Wei-Tong-Xin
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, WTX inhibited the activation of Parkin-dependent mitophagy and apoptosis.

relationships.subject: ML385
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that ML385 counteracted the regulation of WTX on mitophagy and apoptosis.

key_findings: WTX inhibited cisplatin-induced mitophagy and apoptosis in gastric antral mucosa via the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway; Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 reversed the effect.
